10.caption: Jeff is having a bad day, and is determined to make it everybody else's problem.

20.caption: Jeff was scolded for scratching the arm of the couch.

25.caption: Jeff is freaked out by the vacuum. Wemay needto earn back his trust... with treats.

35.caption: Jeff is a bit stressed out by unusual, loud noises that the neighbors are making.

40.caption: Jeff is trying to convince us that he's starving. (His food bowl is still half full)

45.caption: Jeff is hidden under the bed. He may be frightened, or just needs some peace and quiet.

50.caption: Jeff can't find any birds or critters to watch outside through the window today.

54.caption: Jeff is having some difficulty finding a good spot to nap.

58.caption: Jeff lost a toy under the couch. It didn't take long for him to pick out a new toy.

62.caption: Jeff woke up, ate, played, and went back to sleep.

66.caption: Jeff is begging for extra treats today. It won't work, but we admire the enthusiasm.

70.caption: Jeff wound himself up too much while playing today. He's overstimulated now.

74.caption: Jeff is staring directly into the sun. Don't worry, he seems to like it.

78.caption: Jeff is happily sleeping in the middle of the living room floor.

82.caption: Jeff is playing with his toys today. We doubt he'll clean up after himself.

86.caption: Jeff had a wonderful big stretch, then fell asleep in a ray of sun.

90.caption: Jeff stole a piece of "Human Food" and devoured it out of sight.

94.caption: Jeff got a lot of attention today. He enjoyed being the center of attention.

98.caption: Jeff was called "The cutest big boy ever" and that meant a lot to him.

100.caption: Jefferson is having the BEST DAY EVER, full of treats, play, sunshine and naps.
